name: How long does a bathroom expansion project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom expansion project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most full bathroom expansions take several weeks to a few months, depending on the project scope. A project that only shifts non-bearing interior partition walls moves much faster than one requiring an exterior foundation, roofline integration, or substantial plumbing reroutes. The timeline generally moves through design planning, permitting, structural framing, rough-in mechanicals, drywall installation, waterproofing, and tile placement before installing fixtures. Unforeseen issues behind older walls or custom vanity lead times can also adjust the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A bathroom expansion typically takes several weeks to a few months, depending on permitting, structural framing needs, plumbing relocations, and finish installations.
